name: Official Notice of Truancy
description: Notice after a third unexcused absence describing consequences of habitual truancy, the cyber charter transfer restriction, and available resources; may set an attendance improvement conference.
preparedBy: School principal, vice principal, assistant principal or designee
recipient: Person in parental relation (and biological/adoptive parent where applicable)
deadline: within ten (10) school days of a child's third unexcused absence
quote: Within ten (10) school days of a child’s third unexcused absence, the school principal, vice principal, assistant principal or designee shall send an Official Notice of Truancy.
